P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait is present anywhere on the page; the layout is entirely text and data-driven.

P05.rationale: The client (Cordes Consulting) is named in the sidebar but there is no portrait image — only a text block where a photo would be expected.

P07.rationale: A single pull-quote testimonial from the client appears in the right column, but there is no logo wall, rating card, or review grid to constitute a fuller social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: Large opening quotation marks ('66') appear before the testimonial, providing a modest decorative typographic element, but no giant ghost numerals or other oversized glyphs are used.

P11.rationale: Three bold stat callouts ('6 von 6', 'von Headcount…', '0') anchor real outcomes to numbers, but they are typographic callouts rather than actual charts, graphs, or before/after visualisations.

P12.rationale: The upper two-thirds of the page is reasonably filled with structured text and sidebar stats, but the lower quarter of the page is largely empty, preventing a truly dense editorial feel.

P13.rationale: A very subtle warm off-white paper texture is visible in the background, providing a slight atmospheric quality, but it is minimal and barely distinguishable from flat white.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable; score reflects absence of the device.

P16.rationale: No device mockup (phone, laptop, book, or similar product) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: There are no stock photos at all — the page is text-only — so generic imagery is not a problem, though the absence of any specific imagery also limits authenticity.

N08.rationale: The bottom quarter of the page is a large, content-free white region that constitutes noticeable dead whitespace and undermines the editorial density.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photograph; all text sits on clean backgrounds, so there is no legibility issue from this cause.
